name: Xiaoyi OAuth
description: Xiaoyi OAuth: sign in with a Huawei account (no XiaoyiWork desktop app needed), call Xiaoyi cloud models directly, and see AI points/plan quota. Windows only; PKCE OAuth + encrypted credential storage.
author: WenPaul

zh-CN.description: 直接用华为账号登录（无需安装小艺Work），直连小艺云端模型接口；显示 AI 积分/会员额度，自动续期，重写标准 OpenAI 流式分帧与 [DONE]，合并工具调用，支持 low/medium/high 思考档位。
